default/30743.htm.text: Chest of Wisdom: (A voice comes out of the chest.) I have wisdom contained in me. That is why I am called the chest of wisdom.

Q00334_TheWishingPotion/30743-02.html.text: Chest of Wisdom: [A voice emanates from the chest] I will tell you a secret that will bring you great riches. Find the Forbidden Love Scroll and take it to Torai. You will be amply rewarded.

Q00334_TheWishingPotion/30743-03.html.text: Chest of Wisdom: [A voice emanates from the chest] I will tell you a secret that will increase your wealth. Warehouse Keeper Sorint, Magister Paige, Researcher Lorain, Warehouse Keeper Hagger, Guard Stan, Blacksmith Dunning, Trader Ralford, Head Blacksmith Ferris, Warehouse Keeper Collob and Grocer…

Q00334_TheWishingPotion/30743-04.html.text: Chest of Wisdom: [A voice emanates from the chest] I will teach you how to use the Wish Potion correctly. If you wish to become a ruler, you will meet the Devil himself...

Q00334_TheWishingPotion/30743-05.html.text: Chest of Wisdom: [A voice emanates from the chest] I will teach you how to use the Wish Potion correctly. If you wish to find love, a succubus will seduce you and then inflict great pain upon your manhood.

Q00334_TheWishingPotion/30743-06.html.text: Chest of Wisdom: [A voice emanates from the chest] You are the chosen one. I give you the gift of knowledge.
